content.text:
k3d=v5.9.0
k3d version v5.9.0
k3s version v1.35.5-k3s1 (default)

observation.command: cd /tmp && K3D_VER=$(curl -sS -m 20 https://api.github.com/repos/k3d-io/k3d/releases/latest | grep -o '"tag_name": "v[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4) && echo "k3d=$K3D_VER" && curl -sS -L -m 180 -o k3d "https://github.com/k3d-io/k3d/releases/download/${K3D_VER}/k3d-linux-amd64" && chmod +x k3d && mv k3d /usr/local/bin/ && k3d version
